articles.summary: Most product pages show every shopper the same row. Personalized recommendations react to what each shopper is looking at right now, and they're now in every plan of the Depict app on Shopify. Why it matters, how we built it, and why it's a milestone for us.
articles.title: Why personalized product recommendations matter

articles.summary: Sell-through rate tells you what is slow, not why. How to read it before Black Friday, and what to change on the page before you reach for a discount.
articles.title: How to use sell-through rate before you mark down
